name: JokInTheBox
fix_description: In unstake, add require(!stakes[msg.sender][stakeIndex].unstaked) check at the beginning. The function sets unstaked=true but never checks it, allowing the same stake to be withdrawn repeatedly until the contract is drained.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is very short and essentially a single-bug abuse: stake once, warp time, then repeatedly call unstake in a loop to drain rewards/tokens due to flawed unstake/accounting logic. It involves only one protocol plus simple swaps in and out, with no complex DeFi primitives, flash-loan mechanics, or deep multi-contract reasoning.
